shell.cantReachApiBody: Your repositories could not be loaded. Check that the Repowise server is running, then reload.
shell.titleDirectoryMissing: Directory missing — open Workspace to remove or fix
shell.titleNotIndexedSynthetic: Not indexed yet. Open Workspace to index.
shell.titleNotIndexedRepo: Not indexed yet. Open the repo to index.

commandPalette.label: Command palette
commandPalette.placeholder: Jump to a file, search pages, navigate repos…

shell.feedback.title: Help us improve Repowise
shell.feedback.description: Found a bug or have an idea? It goes straight to the maintainers, and we read every message. It's anonymous by default — no account needed.
shell.feedback.failed: Couldn't send feedback. Please try again.
shell.feedback.messagePlaceholder: Tell us what's working, what's broken, or what you'd love to see...
shell.feedback.anonymous: Submitted anonymously. We only see your email if you add one above.
shell.reindexHint.body: This index was built by an older repowise. It still works, but a reindex is recommended to pick up the latest format.
shell.whatsNewModal.title: What's new in repowise

errors.notFoundBody: The page you requested doesn't exist. It may have been moved or never existed.
errors.errorFallback: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

dashboard.title: Repositories
dashboard.description: Everything repowise has indexed from this machine.
dashboard.intro: {files} files and {symbols} symbols are under intelligence here, with {pages} documentation pages written from them. Every figure below is measured from the index rather than estimated.

ribbon.hotspotsSub: files by churn and prior fixes

dashboard.indexingNowDescription: Progress streams live; this page does not need a refresh to catch up.
dashboard.repositoriesDescription: Ordered by what needs attention first — never indexed, then behind their working tree, then by health score — rather than by when they last changed.
dashboard.recentActivityDescription: The last indexing and sync runs across every repository.

attention.unindexedMany: {count} repositories have not been indexed yet.
attention.behindOne: {name} is behind its working tree — run repowise update in it to catch up.
attention.behindMany: {count} are behind their working trees — run repowise update in them to catch up.
attention.lowestScore: Lowest health score is {score} out of 10, in {name}.
attention.nothingAnalysed: None of them has been analysed yet, so there are no health scores to compare.
attention.allCurrent: Every index is current with its checkout. {parts}

files.title: Files
files.description: Drill the map to see how the tree is shaped and where health is thin, then filter the table to find a specific file.

stats.title: By the Numbers
stats.description: The things about this codebase you can't see anywhere else: how big it got, when it started, when the work happens, and the records it holds.

commits.title: Commits
commits.description: Every commit scored for change-risk against this repo's own history, so 'elevated' means elevated here rather than on some global curve.
commits.emptyDescription: Every commit scored for change-risk against this repo's own history.
commits.emptyHint: Per-commit change-risk is captured on the next full index. Run a sync and the review queue fills in behind it.
commits.evolutionDescription: Commit categories over time, read off the subject line. Fixes carry the accent because that is the series this chart exists to show.

codeHealth.title: Code health
codeHealth.trendDescription: How the scores have moved across indexed snapshots.

knowledgeGraph.title: Knowledge Graph
knowledgeGraph.description: Explore your codebase like a map: scroll to zoom, drag to pan, and double-click any card to dive into its layers, folders and files, ranked by how the code actually runs.
knowledgeGraph.error: Could not load the knowledge graph for this repository.

refactoring.title: Refactoring
refactoring.description: One opportunity per file: the ordered steps the health pass wrote from your code. Open one to see the change, or hand it to a coding agent.
refactoring.promptDescription: A ready-to-paste plan that hands your AI coding agent the ordered steps, which of them are mechanical, the evidence behind the diagnosis, and the id to query it back.

decisions.title: Decisions
decisions.description: What this codebase has settled on and what is true of the checkout you are standing in: the constraints, the tradeoffs, and the facts that catch people out.
decisions.checkoutDescription: Facts about the working tree rather than claims anybody made about it, derived at index time with no model call and no history. These are the ones that trip up a newcomer, human or agent.
decisions.reviewDescription: Split by what each record's acceptance amounts to, not by a status word. Every record is in exactly one lane and the counts add up: what governs, what nobody has reviewed, what has drifted from the code it names, what names nothing at all, and what has been retired.

contributors.title: Contributors
contributors.description: Who knows what, mined from full git history. Ownership follows whoever wrote the surviving lines, not whoever committed last.

costs.title: Usage & savings
costs.description: What agents avoided, what Repowise cost, and how we know.
costs.spendDescription: What Repowise's own model work cost, reported beside agent savings and never subtracted from them.
costs.savingsEmptyDescription: Route noisy commands through repowise distill, or install the rewrite hook with repowise hook rewrite install. Savings appear here on their own once an agent starts using this repository.
costs.bySourceDescription: Which capture surface produced each part of the total.
costs.opportunitiesDescription: Behaviour that could have been optimised and was not. Never part of the total above.
costs.detailsDescription: The same savings, cut by day, operation, pricing model and agent.

repoSettings.title: Settings
repoSettings.description: Indexing, model keys and health for {repo}. Server, webhook and editor configuration are shared across repositories.

globalSettings.title: Settings
globalSettings.description: How this dashboard reaches your server, which model it defaults to, and what the MCP server offers an agent. Changes save as you make them.
globalSettings.footer: Sync schedule, exclude patterns and deletion are per repository, on {link}.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: Every repository registered in this workspace, and what connects them.
workspace.emptyDescription: Run `repowise init .` in the workspace root to scan for git repositories and index them. They show up here as soon as the scan lands.
workspace.reposDescription: Ordered by what needs attention first — never indexed, then missing on disk, then by health score — rather than by name.
workspace.contractsDescription: Routes, topics and tables one repository publishes and another consumes, matched across the workspace.
workspace.coChangesDescription: Cross-repo file pairs that recent commits touched in the same session. A work-pattern signal mined from git history, not a declared dependency.

settings.connection.title: Server
settings.connection.description: How this dashboard reaches your repowise server. Stored in this browser, not on the server.
settings.connection.urlHint: Leave blank to use the same origin, which is what a Next.js proxy setup wants.
settings.connection.apiKeyHint: Only needed when REPOWISE_API_KEY is set on the server.
settings.connection.testHint: Checks that the server answers and reports what it is running.
settings.webhook.title: Webhooks
settings.webhook.description: Register one of these in GitHub or GitLab and a push re-syncs the index. The URLs use this dashboard's address, so substitute a public hostname if the host cannot reach it.
settings.webhook.signatureHint: Omit both to skip verification while developing locally.
settings.webhook.serverOnly: Set on the server, not here.
settings.providerPanel.keySavedDescription: Written to this repo. Test it to confirm it works.
settings.display.title: Display
settings.display.description: What this browser shows and how it presents it. Nothing here changes the index.
settings.display.weekendHint: Drives the “on weekends” share on the coding-rhythm heatmap.
settings.display.chatDockHint: The chat pill in the bottom-right of every repository page. Hiding it also hides the two controls below, and does not affect the full chat page.
settings.display.chatDockAria: Show the Ask Repowise chat pill
settings.display.chatAskHint: The small chat button beside a file, symbol, finding, decision or commit. Hiding it removes those buttons; the pill and the full chat page still work.
settings.display.chatAskAria: Show the Ask about this buttons
settings.display.chatSelectionHint: The control that appears when you select text in code or documentation. Hiding it removes that control; selecting text behaves normally.
settings.display.chatSelectionAria: Show the Ask about selection control
settings.display.chatGatedHint: {hint} Unavailable while Ask Repowise is hidden.
settings.mcp.title: Editor config
settings.mcp.description: Paste this into Claude Code, Cursor or Cline to let the agent query this codebase. Replace the path with the repo you want served, and index it first so there is something to answer from.
settings.mcp.serverHint: Goes in your editor's MCP config file.
settings.mcpTools.title: Tool surface
settings.mcpTools.description: Which tools the MCP server offers an agent. Saved to the repo's .repowise/config.yaml and applied the next time you start repowise mcp for it.
settings.mcpTools.empty: Index a repository and its tool surface shows up here.
settings.mcpTools.repoHint: The surface is stored per repo.
settings.mcpTools.summaryWorkspace: Workspace mode, so workspace-only tools are available.
settings.mcpTools.summarySingleRepo: Single-repo mode, so workspace-only tools are unavailable here.
settings.provider.title: Model defaults
settings.provider.description: Used when you trigger init or sync from this dashboard.
settings.provider.descriptionWithServer: Used when you trigger init or sync from this dashboard. The server itself is currently configured with {provider}.
settings.provider.modelHint: Leave blank to use the provider's default.
settings.provider.embedderHint: What semantic search is built from. The mock embedder disables it.
settings.provider.embedderOffNote: Semantic search is off. Set REPOWISE_EMBEDDER=gemini or REPOWISE_EMBEDDER=openai on the server for real retrieval.

repos.delete.title: Delete repository
repos.delete.confirm: This will permanently delete <repo>{name}</repo> and all its generated pages, symbols, and history.
repos.empty.title: No repositories yet
repos.empty.description: Point repowise at a local git repository to build its index, docs, and health signals.
repos.empty.terminalHint: Prefer the terminal? Run repowise init in a repo, or see the setup guide.
repos.firstIndex.title: This repo hasn't been indexed yet
repos.firstIndex.description: One click builds the code index, health signals, and documentation. You can watch it happen live.
repos.coordinator.wikiPagesHelp: Generated wiki pages in SQL vs the matching page vectors in the vector store.
repos.coordinator.pageDriftHelp: How far the wiki-page count disagrees with the page-vector count. 0% means every page is embedded; high drift usually means an interrupted index — run a sync to reconcile.
repos.coordinator.decisionsHelp: Decision records in SQL vs the matching decision vectors. Decision vectors are counted separately from page vectors.
repos.coordinator.decisionDriftHelp: How far the decision-record count disagrees with the decision-vector count.
repos.coordinator.noData: No data — click Refresh to load.
repos.ops.title: Operations
repos.ops.resyncConfirm: This regenerates every page for <repo>{name}</repo> from scratch. All existing pages will be overwritten.
repos.settings.regenDescription: The documentation style was changed to "{style}". Regenerate the whole wiki now to apply it? This runs LLM generation (a cost). You can also do it later from Sync.

docs.viewer.bugFixesTitle: Bug-fix commits that touched this file in the trailing defect window.
docs.viewer.historyCapped: History capped during indexing, so older commits are not counted above.
docs.explorer.emptyBody: Run a generation job to create AI-powered documentation for this codebase.
docs.explorer.askQuestion: Explain "{title}" using the source code, and name the files it rests on.
docs.bulk.title: Write the subsystem pages
docs.bulkConfirm.description: Write every subsystem page still generated from structure, with your configured model.
docs.bulkConfirm.writePages: Write {count, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}}

zoom.breadcrumb.label: Zoom location
zoom.hint.doubleClick: Double-click a card to dive in
zoom.export.title: Download this repository's architecture as Structurizr DSL
zoom.export.workspaceHint: Complete file with default views. Opens as-is in Structurizr.
zoom.export.fragmentHint: Model block only, to !include from a workspace.dsl you already have.
zoom.mapKey.showingFiltered: Showing <verbs>{list}</verbs> only. Arrow weight is how many file pairs the relation covers.
zoom.mapKey.hoverHint: Hover a card to see what it depends on. Arrow weight is how many file pairs the dependency covers.
zoom.mapKey.unclaimed: {shown} of {total} files are not on the map; they belong to no layer.
zoom.mapKey.entryDotHelp: Entry point, hotspot, dead code or on an execution flow. Hover for which.
zoom.mapKey.healthBand: Code health: {good} from {goodMin}, {fair} from {fairMin}, {needsWork} from {needsWorkMin}, {atRisk} below that.
zoom.detail.healthOutOfTenSubtree: Code health out of 10, averaged across this subtree weighted by size
